Game Overview

At its heart, Runaway Toad is a animal game about help a toad escape a relentless princess in Runaway Toad. Master the art of strategic jumping by controlling leap power, navigating treacherous landscapes, and dining on flies. Embark on a whimsical journey across magical terrains, striving for freedom, while unlocking new toads along your escape. Will your hops ensure liberty?
